steps: Danna Alƙibla a babban shafi (ko ka nemo ta a cikin Ƙari).
Ka bai wa manhajar izinin shiga wurinka idan ta tambaya, domin ta saita inda kake fuskanta a halin yanzu kai tsaye.
Riƙe na'urar a kwance; idan kamfas yana buƙatar daidaitawa, motsa ta kamar siffar lamba 8 — maɓallin (?) a shafin Alƙibla zai nuna maka yadda ake yi.
Kibiyar za ta nuna wajen Ka'aba kai tsaye da zarar an gama daidaitawa.

items.q: Yadda ake canza hanyar lissafin lokutan sallah da mazhaba
steps: Daga Ƙari → Saituna → Hanyar lissafi.

Zaɓi hukumar da ta dace da yankinka: Hukumar Masar ta Ƙasa (Egyptian General Authority), Ummul Ƙura, Ƙungiyar Musulmi ta Duniya (Muslim World League), Jami'ar Karachi, ko Ƙungiyar Musulunci ta Arewacin Amurka (ISNA).
Don daidaita lokacin La'asar, danna "Mazhaba — gyaran sallar La'asar" ka zaɓi "Shafi'iyya / Hanbaliyya / Malikiyya" ko "Hanafiyya".
Kana kuma iya gabatar da ko jinkirta kowace sallah da hannu daga "Daidaita lokutan sallah (gabatarwa/jinkirtawa)" a shafin Saituna ɗaya.

items.q: Kunna sanarwar kiran sallah da tabbatar da cewa tana aiki a bango
steps: Daga Ƙari → Saituna → Sanarwa, kunna "Sanarwar sallah" (sai an fara saita wurinka).

Domin kiran sallah ya ci gaba da aiki ko bayan ka rufe manhajar: a Ƙari → Saituna, danna "Kunna aiki a bango (don tabbatar da sanarwa)" don buɗe shafin manhajar a saitunan na'urarka, sannan ka buɗe Battery (batir) ka zaɓi "Unrestricted" (ba tare da taƙaitawa ba) ko ka kashe battery optimization (rage amfani da batir) a kanta.

Wasu wayoyi (kamar Xiaomi, Huawei, da Samsung) suna ƙara wani makulli a kan manhajojin da ke aiki a bango — nemi 'Autostart' (farawa kai tsaye) ko 'App Protection' (kariyar manhaja) a saitunan na'ura ka kunna su ga Rafiq Al-Muslim.

items.q: Zan iya sauraron karatun Alƙur'ani ba tare da intanet ba?
steps: Buɗe Mushafi, danna alamar menu (☰) a sama, ka zaɓi "Sauti".
A shafin "Masu karatu", danna alamar sauke kusa da mai karatu don sauke dukkan karatunsa, ko ka buɗe mai karatun ka sauke surorin da kake so kawai.
Da zarar an sauke, za ka iya saurara a kowane lokaci ba tare da intanet ba; manhajar kuma tana adana ayoyin da ka riga ka kunna.
Kana iya sarrafa ko goge karatun da aka sauke daga Ƙari → Saituna → Bayanan da aka adana.

items.q: Yadda ake amfani da Tasbihi tare da gane murya don zikiri
steps: Daga shafin Tasbihi, danna alamar makirufo.
Ka ba da izinin makirufo a farkon amfani.
Ka faɗi zikirin a fili; manhajar za ta gane shi ta ƙara ƙirga kai tsaye.
Gane murya yana aiki da Larabci kawai, domin tabbatar da gane azkar daidai.

items.q: Ƙara sabon zikiri ko goge ɗaya daga jerin azkar
steps: Daga shafin Tasbihi, danna alamar jeri (≡) a sama don buɗe jerin azkar.
Don ƙarawa: danna alamar + a sama, sannan ka shigar da rubutun zikirin da adadin da ake nufi.
Don gogewa: danna alamar gyara (✎), sannan ka danna maɓallin gogewa kusa da zikirin da kake so (ba za a iya goge azkar na asali ba).
Kana kuma iya sake tsara azkar ta hanyar latsa alamar ja na ɗan lokaci ka ja shi.

items.q: Me ya sa sautin kiran sallah yake jinkiri wani lokaci a iPhone?
steps: iOS yana taƙaita kunna sauti a bango don adana caji, don haka faɗakarwar kiran sallah na iya jinkirta 'yan daƙiƙoƙi bayan ainihin lokacin.
Ka tabbata an kunna sanarwa ga manhajar daga iPhone Settings (Saituna) → Notifications (Sanarwa) → Rafiq Al-Muslim.
Ka kuma tabbata yanayin 'Do Not Disturb' (Kada a dame ni) ko 'Focus' (Mai da hankali) ba a kunne yake ba a lokacin sallah.

Ka buɗe manhajar aƙalla sau ɗaya a kowane 'yan kwanaki: tana tsara kiran sallah ne na 'yan kwanaki masu zuwa kawai (iPhone yana iyakance yawan faɗakarwar da manhaja za ta iya tsarawa), kuma buɗe ta yana sabunta jadawalin.
Daga Ƙari → Saituna → Harshe.
Zaɓi daga harsuna 12 da ake tallafawa: Larabci, Turanci, Urdu, Farisanci, Turkanci, Indonesiyanci, Malay, Rashanci, Hindi, Bangla, Hausa, da Faransanci.
Ana aiwatar da sabon harshen nan take a dukkan manhajar.

items.q: Yadda ake kunna yanayin duhu da tsara kamanni
steps: Daga Ƙari → Saituna → Kamanni da yanayin dare.
Zaɓi jigon launi da kake so daga tarin da ake da shi.
Zaɓi yanayin nuni: Kai tsaye (bin tsarin na'ura), Yanayin haske, ko Yanayin duhu.

items.q: Ta yaya zan sarrafa sararin da manhajar ke amfani da shi a na'urata?
steps: Daga Ƙari → Saituna → Bayanan da aka adana.
Za ka ga jimillar sararin da aka yi amfani da shi, an raba shi gwargwadon littattafan hadisi, karatun Alƙur'ani, da sautin azkar.
Kana iya share littattafan hadisi ko karatun da aka sauke ɗaya bayan ɗaya, ko ka yi amfani da "Share ma'ajiyar wucin gadi" don share su duka — har da sautin azkar — a lokaci ɗaya.

items.q: Kunna aiki a bango a wayoyin Xiaomi (MIUI)
steps: Buɗe Settings (Saituna) na na'ura → Apps (Manhajoji) → Manage Apps (Sarrafa manhajoji) → Rafiq Al-Muslim.
Kunna 'Autostart' (farawa kai tsaye).
A ƙarƙashin Battery Saver (adana batir), zaɓi 'No restrictions' (babu taƙaitawa) maimakon 'Battery saver' (adana batir).
Daga babban shafi, buɗe Recent Apps (manhajojin baya-bayan nan), latsa Rafiq Al-Muslim na ɗan lokaci, ka kunna 'Lock' (kulle) don hana tsarin rufe ta.

items.q: Kunna aiki a bango a wayoyin Huawei da Honor
steps: Buɗe Settings (Saituna) na na'ura → Battery (batir) → App Launch (ƙaddamar da manhaja).
Nemo Rafiq Al-Muslim ka kashe sarrafawa ta atomatik.
Kunna da hannu: Auto-launch (farawa kai tsaye), Secondary launch (farawa ta biyu), da Run in background (aiki a bango).
Ka kuma tabbata an ƙara manhajar a jerin Protected Apps (manhajoji masu kariya) idan akwai shi.

items.q: Kunna aiki a bango a wayoyin Samsung
steps: Buɗe Settings (Saituna) na na'ura → Device Care (kula da na'ura) → Battery (batir) → Background usage limits (iyakokin amfani a bango).
Ka tabbata Rafiq Al-Muslim ba ya cikin 'Sleeping apps' (manhajoji masu barci) ko 'Apps that are put to sleep automatically' (manhajojin da ake sa su barci kai tsaye).
Daga saitunan manhajar kanta, zaɓi Battery (batir) ka zaɓi 'Unrestricted' (ba tare da taƙaitawa ba).

items.q: Me ya sa iPhone ba ya komawa yanayin shiru kai tsaye a lokacin sallah?
steps: iOS ba ya barin kowace manhaja ta waje ta canza yanayin sauti ko ta kunna 'Do Not Disturb' (Kada a dame ni) kai tsaye a madadin mai amfani — wannan wani hani ne da Apple ya sanya wanda ya shafi dukkan manhajoji.
A madadin haka, kana iya ƙirƙirar 'Focus' (Mai da hankali) na musamman don lokutan sallah daga iPhone Settings (Saituna) → Focus (Mai da hankali), ka tsara shi da hannu bisa lokutan sallar garinka.

items.q: Ba na samun kowace sanarwa daga manhajar ko kaɗan — me zan yi?
steps: Da farko, ka tabbata an kunna "Sanarwar sallah" da/ko masu tunatar da azkar a Ƙari → Saituna → Sanarwa.
Ka tabbata an ba manhajar izinin sanarwa daga saitunan na'ura.
A Android: ka tabbata an cire manhajar daga battery optimization (rage amfani da batir) (duba tambayoyin musamman na na'urori a sama).
A iPhone: ka tabbata ba a kunna 'Focus' (Mai da hankali) ko 'Do Not Disturb' (Kada a dame ni) ba, kuma an kunna sanarwa daga iPhone Settings (Saituna) → Notifications (Sanarwa) → Rafiq Al-Muslim.

items.q: Kamfas a shafin Alƙibla yana ba da alƙibla marar daidai
steps: Ka nisanci duk wani abu mai maganaɗisu da ke kusa (lasifika, murfin waya mai maganaɗisu, wasu na'urorin lantarki).
Motsa na'urar a sama kamar siffar lamba 8 don sake daidaita firikwensin kamfas.
Ka tabbata an kunna wuri mai cikakken daidaito (GPS) a saitunan na'ura.
Sake buɗe shafin Alƙibla bayan daidaitawa don tabbatar da cewa alƙiblar ta tsaya daram.

items.q: Wane harsuna ne neman murya yake tallafawa?
steps: Danna makirufo a sandar nema a babban shafi. Neman murya yana saurare da harshen manhajar na yanzu, kuma nema kansa yana fahimtar dukkan harsuna 12 na manhajar.

Gane murya yana amfani da tsarin gane magana na wayarka don wannan harshe: a Android, manhajar Google (speech services) dole ta tallafa masa — kana iya buƙatar sauke kunshin harshen; a iPhone, dole a kunna Dictation (rubutu da murya) a Settings (Saituna) → General (Gaba ɗaya) → Keyboard (Allon rubutu), tare da ƙara allon rubutun wannan harshe.
Idan wayarka ba ta da tsarin gane magana don harshen manhajar, neman murya zai saurara da Larabci a maimakon haka.
A kowane lokaci kana iya rubuta abin da kake nema da hannu, da kowane harshe na manhajar, a matsayin madadi abin dogaro.

items.q: Daga ina farashin zinariya da azurfa a na'urar lissafin zakka suke fitowa?
steps: Manhajar tana ɗauko farashin zinariya, azurfa, da kuɗaɗe daga majiyoyin jama'a lokacin da ka buɗe na'urar lissafin, tana sake amfani da farashin ƙarshe da aka ɗauko idan bai kai awa 6 ba.
Idan babu intanet, manhajar tana amfani da farashin ƙarshe da aka adana a na'urarka.
A kowane lokaci kana iya shigar da farashi da hannu idan kana son amfani da wani farashi daban da ake amfani da shi a ƙasarka.
